headline: Portfolio Outperformance vs. SPY YTD
summary: As of October 23, 2026, the portfolio set has achieved an average return of 23.05%, significantly outperforming the SPY benchmark return of 12.15%. This results in an average alpha of 10.89%, indicating that the portfolios are not only gaining in absolute terms but also exceeding the benchmark's performance. The top portfolio, 'Random A', has delivered a remarkable return of 43.14%, driven by its strongest holding, PANW, which has returned 145.88%. In contrast, the weakest portfolio, 'Random B', has experienced a slight decline of 2.90%, with its bottom holding, ALB, down 40.14%. This relative performance is particularly noteworthy during periods of market uncertainty, as it suggests resilience compared to broader market trends. Note: Updated 30 minutes before and after market close.
